configurationFields.label: General Settings
configurationFields.description: These settings are for setting up the Stormworks server. They can be changed after world creation.

configurationFields.label: Primary Admin
configurationFields.description: Sets the [Steam64 ID](https://steamid.io/) of the primary (first) admin on the server. Other admins (as well as authorized users and banned users) can be added in-game. See the [Stormworks Guide]() for further information.

configurationFields.label: Player Permissions
configurationFields.description: Player permissions (and whitelisted players) can be set using in-game commands. See the [Stormworks Guide]() for further information.

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server as it appears in the server browser.

configurationFields.label: Save Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the world save, as shown in the file directory.

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required for players to join the server. Default is no password.

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of players allowed to join the server at one time.

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Despawn
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will despawn when they leave. This is recommended for public servers.

configurationFields.label: Physics Timestep
configurationFields.description: Sets the physics resolution.

configurationFields.label: Enable Wildlife
configurationFields.description: If enabled, birds and fish spawn are simulated.

configurationFields.label: Fish Spawn Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the rate of fish spawn around players. Requires Enable Wildlife to be set.

configurationFields.label: World Creation Settings
configurationFields.description: These settings are for world creation. They may not be changed after the world is created. If needed, delete  the "working_server" and "saves" directories to generate a new world.

configurationFields.label: Welt-Seed
configurationFields.description: Sets the seed that will be used for the world generation. Empty = random.

configurationFields.label: Start Island
configurationFields.description: Sets the player base that will be owned on start.

options.data/tiles/arid_island_19_12.xml: Arid DLC: Monkey Brain Launch Site
options.data/tiles/arid_island_8_15.xml: Arid DLC: Uran Wind Power Plant Docks
options.data/tiles/oil_rig_playerbase.xml: Custom: Oil Rig Base (structure workbench only)

configurationFields.label: Starting Currency
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of money the players start with at world creation.

configurationFields.label: Enable Settings Menu
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the custom settings menu in-game (available only for admins if Lock Settings Menu is enabled). Otherwise, make sure to set all of the settings under the "Stormworks - Gameplay" menu since you won't be able to change them in-game.

configurationFields.label: Lock Settings Menu
configurationFields.description: If set, only admins can access the custom settings menu in-game (assuming it is enabled). Otherwise, all players will be able to access the menu if it is enabled.

configurationFields.label: Enable Search & Destroy DLC
configurationFields.description: If set, enables Search & Destroy DLC content for a new world.

configurationFields.label: Enable Industrial Frontier DLC
configurationFields.description: If set, enables Industrial Frontier DLC content for a new world.

configurationFields.label: Gameplay Settings
configurationFields.description: These settings are for configuring gameplay options for a world. Note that changing them may not update a save game. These settings can also be changed in-game if "Enable Settings Menu" under "Stormworks - World Creation" is set. If needed, delete the "working_server" and "saves" directories to generate a new world, or try to edit "scene.xml" under each of these folders (untested).

configurationFields.label: Day & Night Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of the day (in real-time minutes).

configurationFields.label: Sunrise Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the sunrise time (as fraction of day & night length)

configurationFields.label: Sunset Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the sunset time (as fraction of day & night length)

configurationFields.label: Override Time
configurationFields.description: If set, the option to override time will be enabled.

configurationFields.label: Override Weather
configurationFields.description: If set, the option to override weather (fog, wind, rain and snow) will be enabled.

configurationFields.label: Override Wind Direction
configurationFields.description: If set, the option to override the wind direction will be enabled.

configurationFields.label: Enable Vehicle Damage
configurationFields.description: If enabled, vehicles can take damaged. Otherwise, they will be indestructible.

configurationFields.label: Enable Engine Overheating
configurationFields.description: If set, engine overheating simulation will be enabled, thereby allowing engine fires.

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Damage
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can take damaged. Otherwise, they will be indestructible.

configurationFields.label: Enable NPC Damage
configurationFields.description: If enabled, NPCs can take damaged. Otherwise, they will be indestructible.

configurationFields.label: Enable Aggressive Animals
configurationFields.description: If enabled, aggressive animals can spawn.

configurationFields.label: Enable Sea Monsters
configurationFields.description: If enabled, sea monsters (aggressive monsters) can spawn.

configurationFields.label: Enable Lightning
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows lightning that can hit vehicles at some altitude.

configurationFields.label: Enable Infinite Resources
configurationFields.description: If enabled, removes money, fuel and minerals requirements for vehicle workbenches.

configurationFields.label: Enable Infinite Batteries
configurationFields.description: If enabled, removes electric power requirments for vehicle components.

configurationFields.label: Enable Infinite Fuel
configurationFields.description: If enabled, removes fuel and air requirements for vehicle components.

configurationFields.label: Enable Infinite Ammo
configurationFields.description: If enabled, removes ammo requirements for weapons (requires DLC).

configurationFields.label: Enable Ceasefire
configurationFields.description: If enabled, prevents weapon usage (requires DLC).

configurationFields.label: Unlock Components
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server starts with all vehicle components researched (that is, disables research).

configurationFields.label: Show Players On Map
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server displays player icons on the map.

configurationFields.label: Show Vehicles On Map
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server displays player vehicle icons on the map.

configurationFields.label: Show 3D Waypoints
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server displays the player waypoint on the HUD.

configurationFields.label: Enable Third Person Player Camera
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows the third person camera for player characters.

configurationFields.label: Third Person Vehicle Camera
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows the third person camera for player vehicles.

configurationFields.label: Show Name Plates
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server displays player name plates above their characters.

configurationFields.label: Enable No Clip Camera
configurationFields.description: If enabled, prevents the camera from clipping through blocks, thereby preventing the third person view through creation.

configurationFields.label: Enable Photo Mode
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows players to enter photo mode.

configurationFields.label: Enable Map Teleport
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows players to teleport using the map.

configurationFields.label: Enable Fast Travel
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows players to fast travel to bases.

configurationFields.label: Enable Teleport Vehicles
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows workbench-spawned vehicles to be teleported back to bases.

configurationFields.label: Enable Vehicle Spawning
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows authorized players to spawn vehicles and use the workbench.

configurationFields.label: Enable Respawning
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows players to respawn. Disable this setting for hardcore or MMO PvP servers.

configurationFields.label: Enable Vehicle Cleanup On Map
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows player vehicle cleanup using the map.

configurationFields.label: Clear Fog Of War
configurationFields.description: If enabled, removes fog of war on the map (cannot be undone using the settings menu).

configurationFields.label: Unlock All Islands
configurationFields.description: If enabled, sets all bases to a purchased state (cannot be undone using the settings menu).
